questions.question: Which tribe received the inheritance described, alongside Ephraim?
What did the tribes of Joseph complain about to Joshua?
options: Too little water in the dry season
Too little land for so many people
Too rough a terrain to farm well
Too many enemies left in the hills
questions.answer: Too little land for so many people

questions.question: The daughters of Zelophehad received an inheritance among Manasseh's sons.
